name: quirecrute
description: Job search in France: search open job offers collected every night from employers' own career sites and the French civil service job board.

interface.longDescription: Job search for candidates in France. QuiRecrute lists over 200,000 open job offers in France, collected every night from employers' own career sites and from the French civil service job board. Ask for "nurse assistant in Toulouse, permanent contract" or "remote developer": ChatGPT searches up-to-date offers, shows title, employer, location, contract and salary when published, and gives the link to each offer, where candidates apply directly with the employer. Users can also receive new offers by e-mail: the alert is created only when they ask for it and give their own address, and it starts only after they click the link in a confirmation e-mail. No account needed. Limitations: offers in France only, offers and search terms in French; results contain facts and links, never the full ad text or recruiter contact details; temporary agencies and recruitment firms are excluded unless asked.

positive.description: Search jobs by occupation and town
positive.prompt: Trouve-moi des offres d'aide-soignant à Toulouse
positive.expected_behavior: Calls chercher_offres with keywords 'aide-soignant' and place Toulouse; lists about 60 open offers (title, employer, town, contract, link to quirecrute.fr) and a link to the full results page.

positive.prompt: Des postes de développeur en télétravail complet ?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls chercher_offres with keyword 'développeur' and the fully-remote filter; lists matching offers with links.
Calls chercher_offres with keyword 'boulanger', département 31 and contract CDI; lists only permanent-contract offers in Haute-Garonne.

positive.prompt: La première offre est-elle encore ouverte, et jusqu'à quand ?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls voir_offre with the identifier of the first offer; says whether it is still open, gives its deadline when published and the link to apply on the employer's site.

positive.description: E-mail alert with the user's own address
positive.prompt: Préviens-moi par e-mail des nouvelles offres d'aide-soignant à Toulouse, mon adresse est reviewer@example.com
positive.expected_behavior: Calls creer_alerte with the address given by the user; explains that a confirmation e-mail was sent and that nothing is active until the link in it is clicked. Use a mailbox you can read; ignoring the e-mail is fine (unconfirmed requests are deleted automatically).

fr-FR.subtitle: Offres d'emploi en France
fr-FR.description: Recherche d’emploi en France. QuiRecrute rassemble plus de 200 000 offres d'emploi ouvertes en France, relevées chaque nuit sur les sites carrière des employeurs et sur Choisir le service public. Demandez « aide-soignant à Toulouse en CDI » ou « développeur en télétravail » : ChatGPT cherche dans les offres à jour, montre l'intitulé, l'employeur, le lieu, le contrat et le salaire quand il est publié, et donne le lien de chaque offre, d'où vous postulez directement chez l'employeur. Vous pouvez aussi recevoir les nouvelles offres par e-mail (alerte confirmée par un clic). Sans compte.
